description:
Job Title:
Android Reverse Engineer
About Trellix
Trellix is a global company redefining the future of cybersecurity. The company’s comprehensive, open, and native cybersecurity platform helps organizations confronted by today’s most advanced threats gain confidence in the protection and resilience of their operations. Trellix, along with an extensive partner ecosystem, accelerates technology innovation through artificial intelligence, automation, and analytics to empower over 50,000 business and government customers with responsibly architected security. More at https://trellix.com.

Role Overview:
Android Reverse Engineer

Role Overview:

In support of our global Google Reverse Engineering program, we seek highly skilled Android App and SDK Reverse Engineers to join our team. This role will involve analyzing and deconstructing Android applications and SDKs to identify potential security risks and gain insights into their underlying functionality.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Android internals, a strong aptitude for reverse engineering techniques and a passion for unraveling complex software.

Company Overview:

Trellix is a global company redefining the future of cybersecurity. The company’s open and native extended detection and response (XDR) platform helps organizations confronted by today’s most advanced threats gain confidence in the protection and resilience of their operations. Trellix’s security experts, along with an extensive partner ecosystem, accelerate technology innovation through machine learning and automation to empower over 40,000 business and government customers. More at https://trellix.com.

About The Role

- Deep Dive Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of Android applications and SDKs to understand their codebase, architecture, functionality and to identify potential risks.
- Reverse Engineering Techniques: Employ advanced reverse engineering techniques to extract information from various codebases, including decompilation, disassembly, and debugging.
- Risk Identification: Identify user and device risk, data leakage, and malicious code execution within Android apps and SDKs.
- Tool Development: Develop and maintain custom reverse engineering tools and scripts to automate tasks and improve efficiency.
- Security Assessment: Conduct security assessments of Android applications and SDKs to identify potential risks.
- Threat Intelligence: Gather, analyze and report threat intelligence findings related to Android malware, exploits, and emerging security trends.
- Collaboration: Collaborate with security researchers, developers, and other stakeholders to share findings, provide recommendations, and contribute to the development of secure software.
- Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest Android security threats, vulnerabilities, and reverse engineering techniques.

About You:

- We require a minimum of 3 - 5+ years of expertise in one or more of the following: Android Development, Reverse Engineering, Pentesting, Application Security Assessments.
- Our Android Reverse Engineering Program also requires hands on experience with the following:
- Analyzing, unpacking, and reverse engineering code of malicious applications or SDKs.
- Ability to read, comprehend and analyze source code (isn’t this obvious?)
- Static and Dynamic Analysis Techniques
- Reverse Engineering tools such as Jadx, Ghidra, Frida, IDA Pro, Burp, to perform binary and APK analysis
- Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, Flutter, and other mobile software languages
- ELF (Native Binaries) reverse engineering
- Query languages such as SQL
- Participation in a Capture the Flag (CTF) for Mobile software (moved from “Additional” section)

- An understanding of the following topics will be greatly appreciated and utilized
- Android Fundamentals such as Android activity lifecycles, common Android API usage, AOSP, and how an android application is created.
- Techniques utilized by malicious software to harm the user’s device or their data
- Mobile App store policies (Ads, PHAs, Developer, etc.)
- Network traffic analysis; security fundamentals

Role Overview:
Develops and delivers detailed IT and cybersecurity solutions through consulting project activities. Responsibilities include client identification through final invoicing for engagements requiring varied interpersonal and technical skills. Technical responsibilities include problem identification, security monitoring, rapid incident response, threat detection, system architecture definition, software specification/design, implementation, testing, client training, and solution deployment. Performance is typically evaluated based on utilization (i.e., billable hours). Project management activities include interaction with company and client managers and cost/schedule monitoring. May have financial responsibilities including project cost estimating, proposal generation, and invoicing. May participate in sales and proposal presentations in addition to completing ongoing team account activities. Identifies additional product/services opportunities within customer organizations. Performance is typically measured by the capture of the consulting engagement and/or delivery of agreed solutions within budgeted hours.

Job Description:

Trellix Professional Services is seeking a Security Incident Handler with a passion for Cyber Security Defense and a strong understanding of security monitoring and incident response.

We have an onsite Elite team—one of the best Cyber Security consulting teams—working directly with our strategic customer as a joint Security Operations Task Force, and growing this piece of the business is a top priority!

This is a full-time hybrid role (3 days onsite, 2 days remote) with Public Sector Professional Services. You will work hand in hand with the customer’s Cyber Security, IT, and business teams to ensure the highest security around all Trellix Solutions and broader Cyber Security ecosystems. The Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) is responsible for 24x7x365 security monitoring and rapid incident response across the customer’s environments. As the ‘tip of the spear’ and the last line of defense protecting customer data and assets from adversaries, you will exercise judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

Note: This position may require occasional after-business-hour and weekend on-call shifts.

About the Role:

- Manage and perform client work related to our product service offerings, security monitoring, and incident response.

- Act as an integral member of the joint Security Operation Task Force and CSIRT team in a 24x7x365 operations environment.

- Respond to security incidents in a production environment, including investigating/remediating endpoint malware infections and mitigating email-borne threats (phishing/spam).

- Conduct host and network forensics during security incidents, analyzing system artifacts (file system, memory, running processes, network connections) for indicators of compromise (IOCs).

- Identify and mitigate vulnerabilities using alternate or compensating controls where necessary.

- Recognize potential security violations, report incidents as required by regulations, and mitigate adverse impacts.

- Create end-of-engagement reports, technical DFIR (Digital Forensics & Incident Response) reports, and executive summaries describing findings and analysis.

- Author formal reports, architecture designs, optimization guides, and best-practice white papers covering a variety of security topics.

- Interact with company and client managers on cost/schedule monitoring, estimating, proposal generation, and invoicing.

- Help identify and develop new client opportunities, expert services engagements, and potential consulting sales leads.

- Maintain technical proficiency through self-training or formal training while sharing knowledge and mentoring consultant peers.

About You:

- Experience: 3 to 4 years’ experience in Information Security, including operational security monitoring or incident response.

- Education: Bachelor's Degree; technical degree or diploma preferred in computer science, information technology, or a related cyber field.

- Core Technical Expertise:

- Understanding of cyber threats, attack vectors, detection capabilities, incident management processes, and compensating security controls.

- Experience monitoring and leveraging Trellix products: Trellix ePO, Endpoint Security (ENS), Trellix Detection & Response / Active Response (EDR), Advanced Threat Defense (ATD Sandbox), Threat Intelligence Exchange (TIE), Data Exchange Layer (DXL), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), SIEM, XDR, and Email Gateway ATP.

- Monitoring and log analysis across Network/Host IDSs, UEBA, WAFs, Database Security, Firewalls/Routers/Switches/VPNs, File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Active Directory, and OS logs.

- Forensics & Threat Knowledge:

- Host and network forensics capabilities, system artifact analysis, and threat hunting methodologies.

- Basic technical understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK™ framework and MITRE’s Ten Strategies of a World-Class Cybersecurity Operations Center.

- Knowledge of TCP/IP protocol suites (packet/traffic dissection) and OS logging configuration (Syslog, flat-files).

- Familiarity with Windows, Mac, and Linux OS administration, application hardening, and security controls.

- Scripting & OS Skills:

- Strong Linux and Python skills are preferred. Experience with PowerShell, Perl, Go, C#, or general shell scripting is a significant plus.

- Understanding of relevant infrastructure technologies: Virtualization (VMware, Nutanix) and Cloud Services (AWS, Azure).

- Soft Skills & Professionalism:

- Excellent client-facing presentation, verbal, and written communication skills (ability to communicate with technical staff and executive leadership).

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

- Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks independently in a high-tempo environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Market and Buyer Perspective

- Develop a deep understanding of Data Security and Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) buyers, including their priorities, pain points, buying triggers, evaluation criteria and evolving requirements.
- Synthesize insights from customers, prospects, analysts, competitors, Sales and the broader market into actionable recommendations for positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy and product direction.
- Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape across data security markets and identify opportunities for Skyhigh Security to differentiate and win.
- Bring an outside-in perspective to Product, Marketing and Sales decisions and serve as an internal expert on the buyer and market.
- Translate market and buyer insight into clear GTM priorities that help drive pipeline creation, competitive wins, expansion and revenue growth.

Drive Positioning and Messaging

- Own positioning, value propositions and messaging for assigned data security products and solutions.
- Translate technical capabilities into clear customer value, business outcomes and differentiated reasons to choose Skyhigh Security.
- Develop messaging tailored to the priorities of CISOs, Data Security leaders, GRC and compliance teams and other key buying influencers.
- Connect individual product capabilities into broader Skyhigh Security narratives around data security, AI security, risk reduction and compliance.
- Ensure messaging remains consistent, differentiated and relevant across campaigns, content, sales materials, launches and customer communications.

Create Compelling Buyer Content

- Develop and orchestrate high-impact content across the buyer journey, including presentations, solution briefs, ebooks, white papers, blogs, videos, webinars, assessment tools, web content and other assets.
- Create content that helps buyers understand emerging data security challenges and establishes a clear point of view on how Skyhigh Security solves them.
- Partner directly with Demand Generation to turn positioning, buyer insights and market opportunities into campaigns and offers designed to create and accelerate pipeline.
- Define the messaging, content and proof points needed at each stage of the buyer journey to increase engagement and conversion.
- Develop customer-facing content that makes complex security concepts accessible, relevant and compelling to both technical and executive audiences.
- Use campaign performance, pipeline results, field feedback and buyer engagement to continuously improve messaging, content and offers.

Drive Sales and Partner Success

- Own the product marketing strategy for improving Sales and Partner effectiveness for the data security portfolio.
- Equip Sales, Customer Success and Partners with the messaging, knowledge, proof points and tools needed to successfully engage data security and GRC buyers and advance opportunities.
- Develop pitch decks, competitive guidance, discovery questions, value propositions, battlecards, use cases, objection handling and other practical tools designed to improve seller effectiveness and win rates.

- Partner closely with Sales leadership and the field to identify gaps in seller readiness, competitive pressure and buyer engagement, then develop programs to address them.

- Work with Partner Marketing and Channel teams to ensure partners can clearly articulate Skyhigh Security’s value and successfully create and advance opportunities.
- Measure the impact of enablement through field adoption, pipeline progression, competitive performance, win rates and other relevant business outcomes—not simply asset creation or training completion.

Drive Product and Solution Launches

- Lead go-to-market planning and execution for assigned product launches and major innovations.
- Develop a clear understanding of roadmap priorities, capabilities, use cases, target buyers and differentiated customer value.
- Coordinate across Product Management, Demand Generation, Communications, Sales, Partners and Customer Success to ensure launch readiness and effective market activation.
- Develop launch messaging, content, enablement and campaign strategies that translate product innovation into buyer engagement, pipeline and revenue impact.
- Establish clear success measures for launches and assess performance across adoption, pipeline, seller readiness, customer engagement and other relevant business outcomes.
- Use results and feedback to continuously improve future launch programs.

Build Thought Leadership and Market Influence

- Develop thought leadership content that elevates the company beyond individual product capabilities and contributes to category and market conversations.

- Work as a strategic partner to Demand Generation, helping define campaign audiences, value propositions, offers and content that generate and accelerate pipeline.

- Collaborate with Communications, Creative and Digital teams to bring positioning and messaging to life through integrated programs.
- Work effectively across a global organization and influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.
- Manage multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining a high standard for quality and execution.

- Strong track record of applying an AI playbook to accelerate the development of high-quality content for multiple stages of the buyer journey and connecting that content to pipeline creation and acceleration.

本職務は、初期のクライアント対応からクロージングに至るまで、ライフサイクル全体を管理し、プロジェクトを通じてエンドツーエンドのセキュリティソリューションを提供します。主な職務内容は以下の通りです。

技術的な実行力: 技術的な問題の特定・分析、影響範囲の特定、予防策の策定、技術面および運用面の改善提案、ならびにクライアントへのトレーニングの実施。
プロジェクトおよび財務管理: プロジェクトのスケジュールとコストの監視、予算の見積もり、請求書の管理、ならびに社内経営陣とクライアント企業の橋渡し（主な連絡窓口）としての役割。
ビジネス開発（営業活動）: 営業プレゼンテーションへの参加、提案書（プロポーザル）の作成、およびクライアント企業内における新しい製品やサービスの機会の開拓。業績評価指標
（KPI）: 成果は主に、稼働率（請求可能な時間）、コンサルティング案件の獲得成功、および予算時間内でのソリューション提供によって測定されます。

Security Consultant / Project Manager Overview
This role involves delivering end-to-end security solutions through consulting projects, managing the entire lifecycle from initial client engagement to final billing.

Key aspects of the position include:

Technical Execution: Identifying and analyzing technical issues, determining the scope of impact, developing preventative measures, recommending technical and operational improvements, and training clients.

Project & Financial Management: Overseeing project schedules and costs, estimating budgets, managing invoices, and acting as the primary liaison between internal and client management.

Business Development: Participating in sales presentations, drafting proposals, and identifying new product or service opportunities within the client's organization.

Performance Metrics: Success is primarily measured by utilization rate (billable hours), successful acquisition of consulting engagements, and the delivery of solutions within the budgeted time.

主な職責:

技術的な責任: 問題の特定、システムアーキテクチャの定義、ハードウェア/ソフトウェアの仕様策定および設計、実装、テスト、クライアントへのトレーニング、そしてソリューションの導入（デプロイ）。

responsible for 2-3 areas of the above duties to improve your own security skills after consulting with your manager.

- CSIRT support (regulation revision, security planning, security education, security helpdesk, incident response, forensics, malware analysis, etc.)

- IT/OT Security Assessment

- Vulnerability diagnosis, penetration test, etc work experience

・The following qualifications/skills

・Communication and coordination skills with stakeholders including customers (At the moment, it is necessary to have a desire to acquire at least.)
・Passed the Basic Information Technology Engineer Examination (passing is desirable, but there is no problem if you have the same level of knowledge)
・Business level Japanese proficiency (reading, writing, speaking) is required.
・Business level English proficiency (reading, writing and speaking) preferred. (If you are not comfortable with English when joining the company, there is no problem.)

Preferred Experience

- User education pertaining to information security

- Software development and programming experience

- Web application development experience

- Security consulting for government agencies and financial industry experience

- Business sales & pre-sales experience-Previous consulting service experience
